# Laravel Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: a patterns skill for building Laravel applications that stay maintainable as they grow. Its core discipline is boundaries: thin controllers that delegate to service or action classes, Eloquent models with typed casts and scopes instead of query soup in controllers, explicit route bindings, and IO-heavy work pushed into queues with cached reads. It also covers events and listeners, API resources with pagination, and centralized configuration. The examples show the conventional Laravel layout (HTTP, services/actions, models) so new code lands where the next developer will look for it. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance, nothing to install; assumes a working Laravel app and PHP basics; queue and cache sections assume you have workers and a cache driver configured. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
